_readme: Curated video source registry for GenArchitect. Human-editable.
Each channel can be listed by @handle; the refresh script resolves the handle to a channel id via the YouTube Data API when YOUTUBE_API_KEY is set.

WITHOUT a key, only channels with a real 'id' (UC...) are fetched, and only their ~15 most recent videos (RSS). WITH a key, the script pulls each channel's FULL upload history (playlistItems.list) — hundreds of videos, including old re:Invent sessions.
So to populate the large library (re:Invent + community), set the YOUTUBE_API_KEY secret and run the workflow.
id: leave as "" to auto-resolve from the handle (needs the key). Set a real UC id to enable RSS without a key.
How to find a channel id: channel > About > Share > Copy channel ID, or View Source and search 'channelId'.
trustTier drives whether a channel is treated as a curated source (official/aws_events keep all videos) vs. a broad channel (only topic-relevant videos are kept). Verify ids/handles before first run.
